identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Atezolizumab in Combination With Cabozantinib Versus Docetaxel in Patients With Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Previously Treated With an Anti-PD-L1/PD-1 Antibody and Platinum-Containing Chemotherapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Pharmacokinetics of Atezolizumab Given in Combination With Cabozantinib Versus Docetaxel Monotherapy in Patients With Metastatic Non-Small Lung Cancer Previously Treated With an Anti-PD-L1/PD-1 Antibody and Platinum-Containing Chemotherapy

armGroups.label: Atezolizumab + Cabozantinib
armGroups.description: Participants received atezolizumab on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle and cabozantinib orally once daily on Days 1-21 of each cycle.

armGroups.label: Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Participants received docetaxel on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Cabozantinib
interventions.description: Cabozantinib will be administered orally, once daily at a dose of 40 mg on Days 1-21 of each cycle.

interventions.name: Atezolizumab
interventions.description: Atezolizumab will be administered by IV infusion at a fixed dose of 1200 mg on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: Docetaxel will be administered by IV infusion at a starting dose of 75mg/m2 on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.
